text: 2026年7月28日，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能会见印度尼西亚银行副行长托马斯·吉万多诺。双方就中印尼经济形势和双边金融合作等议题进行了交流。（中国央行网站）
text_en: On July 28, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng met with Bank Indonesia Deputy Governor Thomas Givandono. The two sides exchanged views on China-Indonesia economic conditions and bilateral financial cooperation. (PBOC website)
